purpose: Record the P22-14 doctor command family physical split completion after the P22-13 preflight refresh.
policy: The doctor family is physically split into cmd/gofly/internal/command/doctor. The command package keeps only a thin doctor_adapter.go for help routing, flag parsing, JSON output, stdout/stderr rendering, command registration, and compatibility test entry points.

relatedSharedContracts.reason: doctor nextActions point users to bug support bundles, so doctor extraction must preserve bug --json support bundle fields and redaction guidance.
doctor --json currently writes through shared JSON helpers and must preserve stdout-only JSON output after extraction.

dryRunFindings.finding: doctorCommand now delegates to the doctor package through doctor_adapter.go, preserving package-level printJSON and shared IO helpers without moving JSON/output helpers.
doctor nextActions intentionally reference bug --json support bundles; dry-run tests pin supportBundle schema, redaction, commands, and nextActions before any package movement.
doctorNextActions is covered for fail, warn, and healthy paths so remediation guidance remains stable during future extraction.

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Refresh the command family dependency map after the doctor split and choose the next single-family candidate without moving shared helpers.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore doctor/doctor.go, doctor/doctor_checks.go, and doctor/doctor_test.go back to cmd/gofly/internal/command and remove doctor_adapter.go in one commit if diagnostics, JSON fields, stdout/stderr discipline, support bundle references, or nextActions regress.
